subject: Probability reset & coverage-gap flagging for Q4 renewals
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@cloudworx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Coverage gaps — recommended probability reset for Q4 renewal

Sarah —

Following our intake with CloudWorx earlier this month I pulled together a short coverage view and a recommended probability reset for the upcoming Q4 renewal (attached). Two asks from our side:

1) Can your team confirm whether the procurement timeline is still targetting the week of 2026-11-09? If procurement needs more time, we should lower the probability to reflect timeline risk.

2) There are two uncovered modules in their bill-of-materials (analytics & private deployment audit logs) that could push them into a procurement review. If those features are required for compliance they become gating items for the renewal. Please flag if procurement requires either piece.

Why we recommend a probability reset now:
- Current committed ARR in HubSpot shows $612k but only ~45% coverage once we remove deals with unvalidated procurement blockers.
- Finance asked for a conservative figure for the Q4 forecast by EOD Friday so we want to avoid overstating commit.

I've attached renewal_coverage_Q4_v2.xlsx with a column called "coverage_gap_reason" and a suggested probability overwrite (column: "prob_suggestion"). If CloudWorx confirms the procurement timeline and scope we can keep the current numbers; if not, we should move this to "At Risk" and run a short commit audit.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/CloudWorx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RenewalCoverageQ4

Thanks — would appreciate a quick confirmation from procurement by EOD Wednesday so Sales/Finance can align the forecast.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: renewal_coverage_Q4_v2.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 28 KB)

From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@cloudworx.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage gaps — recommended probability reset for Q4 renewal

Thanks Aditya —

Quick update from procurement: we are still aiming for the second week of November but there is a 2-week review scheduled for the analytics scope on 2026-10-18. If analytics remains in scope we expect one additional compliance review which could push things out. Private audit logs are likely not required for the core renewal but are being discussed for the expansion track.

I can confirm we will know more after the 10/18 review. For now, please treat the probability as "Needs Validation" rather than fully committed. I will loop in procurement@cloudworx.com if you need anything official for your forecasts.

—Sarah
Sarah Lewis
Head of Procurement | CloudWorx Inc.
sarah.lewis@cloudworx.com

Date: 2026-09-21T08:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage gaps — recommended probability reset for Q4 renewal

Thanks both — copying Finance guidance here so we have a single source of truth for the forecast refresh.

Finance note (short): when a procurement timeline is unvalidated and there are feature-level gating items, we should apply a conservative override to the close probability. For the CloudWorx row I'm proposing we update HubSpot with prob_suggestion = 25% and tag with "coverage_gap_procurement". That will reduce our optimistic coverage but give a realistic committed number for the monthly close forecast.

Operational asks for Sales ops:
- Marcus: please run a brief commit audit and add a note in the company timeline that analytics review is scheduled for 2026-10-18. If CloudWorx confirms no gating features after that review we can revert probability back to prior state.
- Aditya: can you confirm whether CloudWorx would consider moving analytics to an add-on post-renewal if procurement wants the core contract to remain clean? That option would materially change the probability calculus.

I'll plan to publish the adjusted forecast for Finance by EOD 2026-09-24 unless we hear a firm date from procurement early.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
